answer: Make every identity join a small mutual pool before it can earn: members lock a violet bond together, and the atlas, a public registry of pool memberships, shows exactly who shares liability with whom. If one member is proven a clone, the whole pool's epoch payout is slashed, so a farm that pools its own clones risks everything on a single detection, while honest strangers vet their poolmates carefully. A raven auditor samples pools at random each epoch and triggers the slash, so adding clones multiplies exposure instead of multiplying reward.
